fineMeshGeneration.scope: Rerun retained original256-facet concentric annulus fine-mesh input that previously exceeded180s. Native2D current solver-quality repair, same level7/minimum7/padding.15/small-alpha.1. Original XY untouched; no new physical flow model or relaxed quality.

interpretation: Convergence and independent discrete-equation verification pass. Fine pressure threshold and nonmonotonic pressure/rotor torque refinement fail. Tight solve confirms this is not removed by iteration tolerance.

existingStabilizationSensitivity.scope: Same original level7 polygon; change only existing small-cell alpha from.1 to.3 or.5, all quality thresholds preserved. Single fine-mesh sensitivity, not a new refinement qualification.

solverQuality.metric_semantics: native 2D solver-topology metrics; OpenFOAM-like formulas are not external checkMesh evidence
native 2D solver-topology metrics; OpenFOAM-like formulas are not external checkMesh evidence

existingStabilizationSensitivity.conclusion: Pressure error reduced to1.515%/1.464% but still above original0.5% gate; no default or solver change adopted.

pressureErrorLocalization.scope: Diagnostic partition of the unchanged all-cell pressure error; no cells excluded and no qualification gate changed. Demeaned error is explanatory only; the original cell0 pressure gauge remains authoritative.

sameBoundaryPolarControl.scope: Independently constructed8192-cell polar control, NOT Cartesian/Cut-cell output. Every inner/outer boundary endpoint and segment exactly matches retained level7 original input; cell partition and wall-face subdivision differ, while polygon geometry is identical. Same existing moving-wall preset and controls as current Cut-cell study; one control is not a refinement qualification.
sameBoundaryPolarControl.interpretation: With identical original polygon geometry and same solver controls, independently built polar cells give much smaller pressure error. Cell count/distribution and boundary-face subdivision differ, so this isolates a mesh/discretization sensitivity, not one proven faulty operator. This reference is NOT Cut-cell output and does not make the existing Cut-cell refinement qualify.
